title: Architectural Sampling: Test-Time Scaling via Computational Diversity in Frozen Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.01687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time scaling often seeks better answers by sampling multiple responses from a frozen model, yet conventional temperature sampling generates every candidate along the same fixed computation path. We introduce architectural sampling, a training-free method that generates candidates through distinct forward computations by reusing selected blocks of decoder layers. Varying the block location and repetition count introduces computational diversity without updating model weights or adding auxiliary parameters. Across five Qwen checkpoints and twelve multimodal benchmarks, architectural sampling improves pass@9 over standard-path temperature sampling by 6.58 percentage points on average at the same nine-candidate budget. Reusing early layers yields the strongest gains, and the improvement in candidate coverage persists even under greedy decoding. The resulting candidates show lower lexical overlap and improve accuracy when used as rollo

translated_title: 架构采样：通过冻结视觉语言模型中的计算多样性实现测试时扩展
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展通常通过从冻结模型中采样多个响应来寻求更好的答案，然而传统的温度采样会沿着同一条固定的计算路径生成每一个候选答案。我们提出了架构采样，这是一种无需训练的方法，通过复用解码器层的选定块，经由不同的前向计算来生成候选答案。改变块的位置和重复次数可以在不更新模型权重或添加辅助参数的情况下引入计算多样性。在五个Qwen检查点和十二个多模态基准测试上，在相同的九个候选预算下，架构采样相比标准路径的温度采样平均将pass@9提升了6.58个百分点。复用早期层带来最大的增益，并且即使在贪心解码下，候选覆盖率的提升依然存在。所生成的候选答案表现出更低的词汇重叠度，并在用作rollout时提高了准确率。
tldr: 提出一种无需训练的“架构采样”方法，通过复用冻结视觉语言模型解码器层块来构造不同的前向计算路径，以计算多样性提升测试时扩展效果，在相同候选预算下平均将pass@9提升6.58个百分点。
en_tdlr: Architectural sampling is a training-free test-time scaling method that generates computationally diverse candidates in frozen vision-language models by reusing decoder-layer blocks, improving pass@9 by an average of 6.58 percentage points over temperature sampling at the same candidate budget.
